fusions.name: Thread Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a hyphal thread at a target up to 5 tiles away for 5 plant damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It slows the target by 15% for 2 seconds and gives it Rot for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Winding Shroud
fusions.desc: A strike that uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 18 necrotic damage, 60% more for each one used. It slows the target by 30% for 3 seconds and gives it Rot for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Bandage
fusions.desc: Wraps you in woven mycelium that restores 4 health a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Stitch
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once, healing you for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
